$comment: The canonical SiteSmith flow. This file describes the journey that was actually run
end to end during the Glarmester Nordlys pilot, not a future architecture. Every module
reference points at a file that exists in the shipped package, and every command here
was executed. Steps are marked `runs` when a script does the work and `agent` when a
coding agent does it from the artefacts the previous step wrote.
Folders are not moved to match this file. The contract comes first; layout follows only
when the contract has held for more than one flow.
name: sitesmith

install.installs: the whole of skills/sitesmith-v3, including scripts/ and knowledge/
install.degraded: without the two browser packages every rendering check withholds its verdict and says so; it never prints a pass it did not earn

files.PROJECT.md: the subject, its nouns and its facts, written by a person or an agent
files.DESIGN.md: what survives across surfaces in one project
files.direction.md: the plan for one surface, written from the template ledger.mjs writes
files.RUN.md: the same order of work, readable
files.critique.json: the six answers, hashed to the render they were written against

steps.stopsWhen: never; it is idempotent and refreshes what is missing

steps.returns: at most three posts, each with why it matched, its risks and its avoidWhen
steps.hardRule: never a complete visual template or a finished look; the results are building blocks and still go through the subject, thesis, autopilot, swap and originality flow
steps.stopsWhen: the best score is below the no-match threshold, and it says so rather than returning the least bad post

resolves: stack and where the stack came from
steps.agentThenDoes: reads RUN.md, fills the direction record, and writes the site in the named stack
steps.stopsWhen: a blocker is listed; the manifest names it and the agent resolves it before building

steps.agentThenDoes: fills every heading; a blank heading fails the check
steps.stopsWhen: the render's fingerprint repeats a recent one, or a device appears on every one of the last three records

writes: journeys/*.spec.mjs where the surface has a path
steps.stopsWhen: two edit attempts on one defect; it is then written down as unresolved
a browser is missing; the verdict is withheld and named, never passed

steps.agentThenDoes: answers the six questions from the images alone, with the record closed; hand the packet to a fresh agent where one is available
steps.stopsWhen: a second correction round is asked for; one is allowed and the second is refused

asserts: the failure path ran and its message sat on its own field
the path completed on the keyboard alone

steps.policy: docs/GATE-POLICY.md — new hard gates need a user-affecting defect, two independent reproductions, a low-false-positive measurement, and proof no existing gate covers it
steps.stopsWhen: it refuses; the way past every refusal is named in the refusal itself
never; it reports and does not refuse. A route it could not read gets no record and is listed as not measured

steps.agentThenDoes: changes only what redesign.md permits, against the baseline inspect wrote

requires: verify passes or names every verdict it withheld
a critique locked to the render that ships
a journey for buy, operate and redesign
gate clean, or every refusal claimed in the direction record with a reason
a production build where the stack has one
release.neverClaims: that the page is good. The gate refuses named defects; the verdict on the design belongs to a person who is shown it.

providers.$comment: Generated packs come from the v2 layer and are unchanged by this file. They expose the same journey under each agent's own entry filename.
